name: UCSF Health Volunteer Program (includes BCH Oakland campus)
org: UCSF Health / UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals
city: Oakland, CA (BCH Oakland) and San Francisco
what_you_do: Non-clinical hospital volunteering: visit and talk with patients, light clerical work, and help patients and visitors find their way. No shadowing, research or internships.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older. You must be 18 to volunteer in pediatric inpatient units or the Emergency Department. Minimum 6 months, one 3 to 4 hour weekday shift each week.
duration: One weekly 3 to 4 hour shift for 6 months
deadline_text: Page update dated Sept 22 (year not stated): registration opens Tuesday Oct 13 at 9:30am only for two high-need SF programs. Other opportunities, including others at BCH Oakland, are listed as full.
how_to_apply: Attend a virtual info session, in-person group interview, online training and health clearance (background check if 18+). Volunteer Services (415) 502-9888.
notes: The Oct 13 opening is for Parnassus and Mt. Zion or Mission Bay programs in San Francisco, not Oakland. UCSF says it cannot take new volunteers for other roles right now. Under 18 needs a parent at the health clearance visit. No high school summer program was found on the official pages.
